_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0011 Section 5 rule 6 as written (seam-embedder-findings proposal S4, owner decision 2026-10-16). An n_of_m override greater than the declared participant count is admitted, because the rule schema cannot see participant counts. It is evaluated as given, and it replaces required_approvals. Five approvals can never come from three participants, so rule 4's second clause makes the Session eligible for a negative Commitment at once, with no ballot cast. A runtime that rejects the ApprovalRequest, or that requires at least one counted ballot before a negative Commitment, diverges from rule 6.
description: Quorum Mode: an n_of_m 5 override over 3 participants is unreachable from the start, so a negative Commitment is accepted before any ballot.

policy.description: n_of_m threshold of 5 over a 3-participant session; deliberately unreachable.

messages._comment: Rule 2 bounds only this payload (required_approvals 2 <= 3 participants). The policy override is not subject to rule 2, so the request MUST be accepted.
Rule 4's second clause: the remaining possible approvals (3) cannot reach the effective threshold (5), so a negative Commitment is accepted with zero ballots. Rule 4b supplies the outcome shape.
